morbi.headline: Morbi shows demand recovery for premium tiles despite sudden propane gas cost shocks.
what_changed: Propane gas prices spiked by Rs 7,300 per metric tonne, pressuring kiln margins.
Major branded tile players reported strong Q2 and H1 earnings, signaling industry recovery.
stress_signals: Propane price increase of Rs 7,300/MT creates immediate margin pressure for propane-fired vitrified and wall tile kilns [2f37d34283cf]
improvement_signals: Kajaria Ceramics beat Q2 2026 sales and profit estimates [c28b87e03125]
Varmora Granito reported a 498% jump in H1 profit driven by premium tile margins, reflecting broader sector recovery [3ede25f378d4, 7995af796f7c]
what_to_watch: Extent to which MSME tile producers can pass on propane price hikes to end buyers.
Capacity utilization rates across unbranded vitrified and wall tile MSME units.
Working capital line utilization and inventory days among smaller Morbi kiln operators.

surat.headline: Pre-Diwali power shortages, wage disputes, and trade defaults pressure Surat's textiles and diamonds.
what_changed: Textile units are grappling with pre-Diwali labor shortages, rising input costs, sluggish demand, and electricity crisis disruptions.
Diamond polishing units face severe pre-Diwali liquidity pressure, leading to wage payment disputes and reported unit defaults.
Textile and gem exporters are seeking new growth avenues via technical textiles, defense fabrics, and new export markets.
stress_signals: Gujarat industrial power cuts threaten weekly textile losses of ₹300 crore and forced market lighting curtailments [37c492915105, 5ae803461fe0].
A major pre-Diwali diamond trader default (uthamnu) involving crores risks severe local artisan distress [8f729a2b282e].
A textile mill operator suffered a ₹1.69 crore fraud due to broker-backed fabric delivery failure [25d6a0f6dbec].
Unpaid worker dues exceed ₹20 lakh across 20 diamond artisans, prompting union representations for Diwali bonuses and overtime [402ab705574d, c8a89bd2019b].
improvement_signals: Expansion into defense fabrics and Mercedes-Benz's technical textile exploration with MANTRA bolster long-term manufacturing scope [c4aec155608f, 3a4ce1852d7c].
India-New Zealand FTA and efforts to rebuild US market share present prospective export growth options [8e92d85d894d, 37e6ab2a18cd].
what_to_watch: Pre-Diwali cash-flow adequacy and bonus payouts among cutting/polishing diamond units to gauge default risks.
Operational continuity and actual power stability across industrial processing houses and loom sheds.
Broker-mediated trade exposures and trade receivable realization rates in MMF textile markets.
Trader adoption rates and operational traction at the Surat Diamond Bourse [b55c8a265aa2].
